entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I bought something, and I think I need to return it. I'm just so confused by the whole thing.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me which product you're calling about?
It's the... the cycling shoes. I ordered them a couple of weeks ago, but they're just not right. The website was a bit overwhelming.

I understand. I'm sorry to hear the new cycling shoes aren't working out for you. To make sure I get you to the right solution, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a preference or fit issue?

I guess it's the fit? I'm not sure. I put the cleats on just like the video showed, but after one ride, I got these awful blisters on my heels. They just feel... wrong. I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. It sounds like it might be a sizing issue. Let me pull up your order. I see it was delivered 16 days ago. One moment while I check the policy for this item.
Okay... I was worried I waited too long.
Not at all. The good news is that these shoes fall under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account now. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That sounds easy enough. Thank you so much for your help, David.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
